benchmark_task_formulation.description: Given a factual historical memory claim c created at base repository state S_base, evaluate whether c remains temporally VALID, has become STALE, or is PARTIALLY_VALID at evolved target repository state S_target.

input_specification.structured_claim: Object: Normalized semantic query slots (module, symbol, attribute, parameters, default, contract)
input_specification.raw_statement: String: Natural language agent memory assertion
input_specification.claim_type: String: One of the 10 formal claim types

observation_context.target_state: Target repository workspace checked out at target_commit
observation_context.budget_constraint: Budget B50 (max 50 tool actions per evaluation session)

prediction_target.abstention_support: Models may output ABSTAIN when confidence is below operating threshold, enabling selective classification analysis.

accuracy.description: Overall proportion of correct validity predictions across all evaluated cases.

macro_f1.description: Unweighted mean of F1 scores across classes, giving equal importance to minority stale claims.

confusion_matrix.description: Full cross-tabulation of actual gold labels versus model predictions.

coverage.description: Proportion of claims where the evaluator makes a definitive decision (non-abstained).

selective_risk.description: Error rate strictly evaluated on decided predictions.

false_invalid_rate.description: Proportion of valid agent memories incorrectly invalidated as stale.

stale_escape_rate.description: Proportion of broken/stale memories that escape detection (falsely predicted valid).

claim_type_breakdown.description: Accuracy, F1, and error rates broken down by individual claim type (DEFAULT_VALUE, SIGNATURE_COMPATIBLE, DEPRECATION_STATUS, BEHAVIORAL_CONTRACT, DEPENDENCY_CONTRACT).

repository_breakdown.description: Macro accuracy and macro F1 averaged across all 25 distinct benchmark repositories.

naive_majority_baseline.description: Always predicts VALID for all claims (Majority class heuristic).

pure_symbol_ast_checker.description: Inspects target AST for symbol existence only; ignores parameter and default mutations.

claim_aware_static_checker.description: Static AST comparison of function signatures, parameter names, and default values without dynamic execution.

zero_shot_direct_llm.description: Prompts LLM directly with structured_claim and target code context snippet.

rag_retrieval_augmented_llm.description: Retrieves top-k target files via BM25/dense retriever and prompts LLM for validity classification.

oracle_upper_bound.description: Theoretical ground-truth oracle with target test suite execution and perfect dependency resolution (100.0% accuracy ceiling).

frozen_rolemem_v2_2_system.description: Frozen RoleMem V2.2 framework under default B50 runtime budget with budget-bounded evidence escalation.

execution_boundary_and_firewall.unsealing_timing: formal_gold_private.jsonl unsealed strictly after prediction file freeze in Phase S7.
